newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sugar exports fall to 22,967 T in March.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sugar exports fall to 22,967 T in March.

text.p: The Mauritius Sugar Syndicate (MSS) exported 22,967 tonnes of sugar in March against 42,830 tonnes in February and 35,957 tonnes in March 1996, an industry report said on Monday.

The report, compiled by the public relations office of the sugar industry, said that of the 22,967 tonnes of sugar exported, 22,226 tonnes were sent to European Union countries, 275 tonnes to the U.S. and 466 tonnes were exported on the world market.

Syndicate officials said the sugar cane harvest season normally starts mid-June and the syndicate exports large volumes between July and December. From January to May sugar exports tend to decline in volume.
Unofficial figures for 1997 sugar production forecast between 600,000 to 620,000 tonnes compared to 590,000 tonnes produced in 1996 and 540,000 tonnes in 1995.
